title: Lists and quotations
summary: Draft a list or quotation and convert it to an invoice once it is accepted.

steps.text: Open {lists} from the sidebar, then click {new} to start a draft.
Click a list or quotation to open it, add or change its lines and see its total.
On {title}, use {dl} for a blank spreadsheet in the expected format, fill it in and upload it to bring in many quotations at once.
You can also ask the assistant to create a list or quotation, reprice it, finalize it or convert it into a document. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
